def dots(fr):
    L=fr.ascii.splitlines()
    px=sorted((r,c) for r in range(len(L)) for c in range(len(L[0])) if L[r][c]=='N')
    clusters=[]
    for p in px:
        for cl in clusters:
            if abs(p[0]-cl[-1][0])<=4 and abs(p[1]-cl[-1][1])<=4:
                cl.append(p); break
        else: clusters.append([p])
    return [(min(r for r,_ in cl),max(r for r,_ in cl),min(c for _,c in cl),max(c for _,c in cl)) for cl in clusters]
for i,h in enumerate(history):
